title: 第一卷 第9章 桃花运第一卷 第10章 青羽鸡王
slug: 老来娶妻的我打造出最强仙族
lines: “夫君，赵猛这是阳谋！”
“他逼我们公开，就是算准了我们加税后更难熬，等着我们撑不住那天！”
阮红菱咬着嘴唇，粉面寒霜道。
“红菱，这不是坏事！”
“这下公开了，你也可以放心怀孕了！”
“也不用面对街坊四邻们的指指点点，我们是光明正大的夫妻！”
林逸搂着阮红菱，笑着安慰道。
“夫君，这样的绝境，你还能笑得出来！”
阮红菱依偎在林逸怀里，娇羞道。
经过赵猛这次搅局，林逸主动为她补交护道税。
她更加确信，自己没有选错人，没有嫁错人。
从现在开始。
她从明面上，也是林逸的妻子，有了名分。
“红菱，别担心！”
“说白了，不就是多交一块下品灵石么？”
“就这么大点事！”
林逸轻轻拍着阮红菱的玉背，面上浮现出一抹洒脱笑容，完全看开了。
公然娶妻。
他就可以放心耕耘，阮红菱若是顺利怀孕的话，就能多结出一枚仙灵果！
一枚仙灵果所带来的提升和收益，必定远远超过一块下品灵石！
这反倒是因祸得福！
“夫君，有你真好！”
阮红菱大为感动，满脸娇羞道。
晚饭过后。
林逸就按耐不住，主动拉着风韵动人的阮红菱，进入洞房。
红烛摇曳。
红蔓晃动。
阮红菱乌发散开，衬得面庞愈发白皙娇媚。
四十岁的妇人，眼角虽有细纹，却不掩风韵。
烛火噼啪作响。
红烛缓缓流淌。
两刻钟后，帐内安静下来。
阮红菱靠在林逸怀里，听着他有力的心跳，心里前所未有的踏实。
二十年了。
她终于等到了这一天。
成为林逸名正言顺的妻子。
“逸哥，我想给你生个孩子！”
阮红菱轻声道。
“一个哪够？”
“咱们生一群孩子，让云梦城林氏，开枝散叶，人丁兴旺起来！”
content_en:
"Husband, this is Zhao Meng's conspiracy!"
"He forced us to make it public because he calculated that it would be even more difficult for us after the tax increase, and he waited for the day when we couldn't survive it!"
Ruan Hongling bit her lip and said with a frosty face.
"Hongling, this is not a bad thing!"
"Now that it's public, you can rest assured that you're pregnant!"
"We don't have to face the judgment of our neighbors. We are an upright couple!"
Lin Yi hugged Ruan Hongling and comforted him with a smile.
"Husband, you can still laugh in such a desperate situation!"
Ruan Hongling snuggled into Lin Yi's arms and said shyly.
After Zhao Meng disrupted the situation, Lin Yi took the initiative to pay the road protection tax for her.
She was even more convinced that she had not chosen the wrong person or married the wrong person.
From now on.
On the surface, she is also Lin Yi's wife and has a status.
"Hongling, don't worry!"
"To put it bluntly, isn't it just to hand over an extra low-grade spiritual stone?"
"It's such a big deal!"
Lin Yi gently patted Ruan Hongling's jade back, a carefree smile appeared on his face, and he looked away completely.
Take a wife openly.
He can work with peace of mind, and if Ruan Hongling gets pregnant successfully, she will be able to produce one more fairy fruit!
The improvement and benefits brought by a fairy spirit fruit must far exceed that of a low-grade spirit stone!
This is actually a blessing in disguise!
"Husband, it's great to have you!"
Ruan Hongling was greatly moved and said shyly.
After dinner.
Lin Yi couldn't hold it any longer and took the initiative to drag the charming Ruan Hongling into the bridal chamber.
Red candles flicker.
The red vines swayed.
Ruan Hongling's black hair was spread out, making her face fairer and more charming.
A forty-year-old woman, although there are fine lines at the corners of her eyes, she does not hide her charm.
Candles crackled.
Red candles flowed slowly.
Two quarters of an hour later, the tent became quiet.
Ruan Hongling leaned in Lin Yi's arms, listening to his strong heartbeat, and felt more at ease than ever before.
Twenty years.
She finally waited for this day.
Become Lin Yi's legitimate wife.
"Brother Yi, I want to give you a child!"
Ruan Hongling said softly.
"How can one be enough?"
"Let's give birth to a group of children so that the Lin family in Yunmeng City can spread its branches and flourish!"
